related.title: MQTT QoS 1：重送與應用去重
related.titleEn: MQTT QoS 1: redelivery and application deduplication
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學管線部分預算500 µs；3跳通過、5跳失敗；未建模的注入相位與傳播不能當作0交付正式保證。 cqf_cycle_matrix.csv、逐跳週期與截止事件 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 375 與變更 625 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching pipeline budget500 microseconds:3 hops pass and5 fail; omitted injection phase and propagation cannot be treated as zero in a formal guarantee. cqf_cycle_matrix.csv, hop cycles and cutoff events Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 375 and changed 625 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學副作用次數需等於唯一事件數3或5；丟掉所有DUP封包不是驗收策略，因第一次可見副本也可能帶DUP。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching side-effect count must equal three or five unique events; dropping everyDUP packet is invalid because the first visible copy may haveDUP set.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成週期125 µs，3跳；擾動5跳，假設每週期容量充足且相位已對齊。 名義式 3*125 = 375 us；變更式 5*125 = 625 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以封包在週期0入站，逐跳列下一週期出站索引1、2、3；5跳延伸到5，檢查不能跳過一個切換週期。

合成收到事件ID[a,b,b,c,c,c]共6筆、唯一3筆；改為[a,b,c,d,e,e]仍6筆、唯一5筆。 名義式 (6-3)/6 = 0.5 duplicate fraction；變更式 (6-5)/6 = 0.166667 duplicate fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以集合和逐筆idempotency表兩種方法計唯一ID；重播同一檔後業務計數不應再增加。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic125 microsecond cycles and3 hops, changed to5, assuming sufficient per-cycle capacity and aligned phase. Nominal 3*125 = 375 us; changed 5*125 = 625 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enter a packet at cycle0 and list egress indices1,2,3, extending to5 for five hops; verify no queue-switch cycle is omitted.

Synthetic received event IDs[a,b,b,c,c,c] give six deliveries and three unique events; change to[a,b,c,d,e,e] with five unique events. Nominal (6-3)/6 = 0.5 duplicate fraction; changed (6-5)/6 = 0.166667 duplicate fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count unique IDs using both a set and a row-by-row idempotency ledger; replaying the same file must not increase business-side counts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEC 61850 GOOSE：重傳與相關遺失
related.titleEn: IEC 61850 GOOSE: retransmission and correlated loss
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學管線部分預算500 µs；3跳通過、5跳失敗；未建模的注入相位與傳播不能當作0交付正式保證。 cqf_cycle_matrix.csv、逐跳週期與截止事件 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 375 與變更 625 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching pipeline budget500 microseconds:3 hops pass and5 fail; omitted injection phase and propagation cannot be treated as zero in a formal guarantee. cqf_cycle_matrix.csv, hop cycles and cutoff events Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 375 and changed 625 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學獨立模型漏接門檻0.005；p=0.1通過、0.3失敗；任何實際保護決策另需期限、網路與裝置驗證。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching independent-model miss limit0.005:p=0.1 passes and0.3 fails; actual protection decisions require deadline, network and device validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成週期125 µs，3跳；擾動5跳，假設每週期容量充足且相位已對齊。 名義式 3*125 = 375 us；變更式 5*125 = 625 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以封包在週期0入站，逐跳列下一週期出站索引1、2、3；5跳延伸到5，檢查不能跳過一個切換週期。

合成觀察窗內三次傳送、各次丟失0.1；擾動0.3，暫假設獨立，並另設共同斷線對照情境。 名義式 0.1**3 = 0.001 all-missed probability；變更式 0.3**3 = 0.027 all-missed probability。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列三位元接收/遺失八種結果，總機率1；加入共同斷線機率c時需改為c+(1−c)p³，不能仍用p³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic125 microsecond cycles and3 hops, changed to5, assuming sufficient per-cycle capacity and aligned phase. Nominal 3*125 = 375 us; changed 5*125 = 625 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enter a packet at cycle0 and list egress indices1,2,3, extending to5 for five hops; verify no queue-switch cycle is omitted.

Synthetic three transmissions within an observation window with loss0.1 each, changed to0.3; assume independence and include a separate common-outage comparison. Nominal 0.1**3 = 0.001 all-missed probability; changed 0.3**3 = 0.027 all-missed probability. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate eight three-bit receipt/loss outcomes summing to one; common-outage probabilityc changes the result toc+(1−c)p cubed.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
